listing.name: Das 4. Reich - A Starfarer Mod
listing.summary: We are planning to make a mod were we add a new faction called the 4. Reich. So we are add new ships, weapons and stuff to it in the next time.
listing.aiSummary: Adds a new hostile faction with Wehrmacht-inspired ships and weapons.

description:
We are planning to make a mod were we add a new faction called the 4. Reich. So we are add new ships, weapons and stuff to it in the next time.

I have received much help from my good friends Flex he made the Faction stuff, bug fixing and big parts of Codeing and Steve0112, he made some textures and talked about ME3, thats the reason i made so much progress in a short time.
At the moment im looking for someone who can draw me some good Wehrmacht Space ship Textures when you got the talent and desire to help, feel free to pm me ;).

No Compatibility tested jet.

It might be incompatible to all Mods that change the Missions (when encounters bugs and problems feel free to pm me)

And please feel free to make some change suggestions or maybe what we should add to oure space Reich mod :P
